notes.title: Bugfixes, Hitbox adjustments, difficulty changes
notes.content:
Bug Fixes:
Fixed a bug where in level1 sometimes after dying players would see the whole level zoomed out.

Hitbox adjustments:
After receiving a lot of feedback about the moving spike hitboxes I decided to smaller them down because they where not too big but very accurate which can give a bad feeling due to the size of the character.

Difficulty adjustments:
Moved the plant in the beginning back a bit so there is more space and people don't quit the game before seeing any of it <3

Quality of life:
Replace the small arrow that was defiantly too small with a better visible Rock

notes.title: new images
notes.content: Added new images for SFW mode so that you can see a reward even if you do not own the DLC.

notes.title: Bug fixes
notes.content:
Fixed a scenario where sometimes players would jump directly to the Credit screen after level4 when playing on Easy.
Fixed an issue where the replay button on level5 would cause the level to instantly end a second time.
